scope: First LAB-only transfer trial; no threshold retuning after test inspection

lab_validation.note: Missing detections count as failures in PCK. Unordered bolt detections are matched by minimum-cost assignment. Diagnostic only; not used to retune the frozen first-fold model.

inference: Missing/invalid field corner detections prevent classification. LAB validation is strong; domain transfer is a plausible explanation, not a proven exclusive cause.
next_step: Human-only field point labels with strict per-fold train/val/test separation; evaluate label budgets in a new documented protocol.
